title: Absolute moved spaces and noncrossing partition posets in arbitrary Coxeter groups
summary: The interval $[1,c]_T$ between the identity element and a Coxeter element $c$ in the absolute order on a Coxeter group $W$ is a generalization of the poset of noncrossing partitions arising when $W$ is the symmetric group. When $W$ is finite, this poset is always a lattice, and it is natural to associate to every element $w\in [1,c]_T$ its \textit{moved space} $\mathsf{Mov}(w)=\mathrm{Im}(w - \mathrm{Id}_V)$ in the geometric representation $V$ of $W$.
